title: Figures 65-66: Tic Tac CFD pressure and temperature contours at 100 mph
description: First page of "ATTACHMENT II - 'TIC TAC' CFD CONTOUR PLOTS FOR PRESSURE, TEMPERATURE AND MACH NUMBER," showing two color contour plots of the capsule-shaped body at 1/6 scale with numeric legends. Captions read "Figure 65. Tic Tac Pressure at 1/6 Scale, Air Temperature 223K and 100 mph with Subsonic Inlet and Subsonic Outlet" (pressure peak at the nose, in Pa) and "Figure 66. Tic Tac Temperature at 1/6 Scale, Air Temperature 223K and 100 mph with Subsonic Inlet and Subsonic Outlet" (warmer wake, in K). Page 116 of the BAASS UAP Analysis Capabilities report.
